title: Hypher Launch
logline: For builders who switch between Claude Code and Codex on one repo: stop re-explaining your project. The next agent starts from one note. Join the pilot at hypher.app.

scenes.intent: The pain: you are typing your project's context into yet another agent, again.

beats.note: the Codex prompt is there; typing starts

text.prompt-text: Again: hash tokens, don’t widen OAuth…
text.headline: Every agent starts from zero.

Label 8px above the prompt, grey
<Input ct="prompt" focus> ~1120px wide, empty value; types into prompt-text, caret prompt-caret (accent as light)

scenes.motion: Solid canvas. b1 (0.15): agent fades, prompt rises (responsive); m.type("prompt-text", { at: 0.3, cps: 22 }) runs to ~2.0, with m.blink("prompt-caret") until the end. b2 (0.7): headline maskUp split lines, ease expressive (the scene's one moment). Camera push 1 → 1.03 over the whole scene, origin on the headline's left edge ({ x: 96, y: 400 }), still moving on the last frame. JOIN OUT (cut on action): no exit; the push and the blinking caret are live at the cut, and the turn's statement rises on its frame 0. The light page cuts to black smoke as the answer arrives.

scenes.intent: The turn: the must-say promise on the site's black smoke, signed by the name.

No camera push: the field moves by itself and the carry out must be a pure translate. JOIN OUT (carry left, 10%): no exit; the carry's lead-in accelerates the whole frame left over its last ~0.2s. The field bleeds past the edge, so the light page arrives at the same speed.

Nothing else is on screen and nothing moves until land (0.9). b1 (0.95): row-constraint then row-decision rise (list stagger, responsive); the typed capture reappears as the constraint. b2 (1.2): headline maskUp lines, ease expressive (the one moment). scenes.motion: Solid canvas. JOIN IN (carry up, 10%, layers from writeback): headline on screen from frame 0, arriving with the wave. save-term rises on frame 0 (its entrance travels up with the carry). 0.4: caption fades. b1 (0.55): m.type("save-cmd", { cps: 20 }) to ~1.15 (the box fades in at b1, then the text types). b2 (1.2): save-out rises, ease expressive (the one moment: saved). Hold. go (2.7): JOIN OUT (match v2): save-cmd tweens x 0 → 360 over the last 0.6s on t², { type: "bezier", p: [1/3, 0, 2/3, 1/3] }, ending at end, so it is fastest on the last frame (v ≈ 1200 px/s). Nothing else moves; the caption stays put (it is paired).

scenes.motion: Solid canvas. JOIN IN (match from save, 0.8s, pairs save-cmd → resume-cmd and caption): resume-cmd leaves the cut at save-cmd's speed (≈ 1200 px/s rightward) and slows into place in the Codex terminal by 0.8. Reach rule: v·d = 960, so the target is 320–640px along. Place it ~480px right of save-cmd's position at the cut, on the same row. resume-cmd has no entrance of its own, and resume-term is already there on frame 0. b1 (0.8): headline maskUp lines, ease expressive (the one moment). b2 (0.95): resume-out rises (responsive). Everything is settled by ~1.4. No caret, no push, no motion after 1.6, so trust's still of this frame is exact. JOIN OUT (portal out via trust's machine-screen, 1.0s from 3.0): the whole shot shrinks into the screen on 'Your machine'.
